scope: Native ray geometry, transport retirement, IMU sampling/ADC, DDS listener lifetime and EGO shutdown regressions. Native fixtures do not grant scene flight acceptance.

transport.reproduced: Concurrent actual Connection destruction double-frees the shared IOManager, producing a native SIGSEGV.
transport.fix: Serialize shared creation/count/final unpublication; delete outside the lifecycle lock.
transport.unchanged: Object ABI, upstream snapshots, protocol, mandatory joins and retained-owner timeout.
additional_fixes: Cancel pending reads still owning removed connections during the explicit terminal phase; retained independent owners still refuse Finish.
Private Connection factories defer complete object destruction only from an executing oneTBB task; ordinary owner teardown remains synchronous, and TaskGroup wait plus IO joins remain mandatory.

ray_box.reproduced: Native ODE returned an intersection at z=0.13 for a box with top z=0.055; moving native fixture reproduced aircraft self returns.
ray_box.fix: Independent finite slab intersection using actual native box pose, dimensions and ray geometry; other geometry uses original dCollide.
ray_box.unchanged: System ODE, aircraft/world geometry, scan pattern, physical noise, blind zone, source timestamps, planner margins.

checks.asan_options: detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1; lifecycle counts and actual joins separately asserted

historical_limits: These independently reproduced defects do not uniquely attribute every historic shutdown failure. The v10 formal matrix passed four cold starts and two two-cycle scene runs, with 24 normal exits per run. Scene qualification is recorded separately in each calibration-s2-final.json and mission-s2-final.json, and is limited to the recorded revision, configuration and central-aisle route.

dds.reproduced: EDP::unpairWriterProxy+406 null listener dereference; real RTPS listener-clear fixture reproduces the same crash.
dds.fix: One listener snapshot under existing reader lock, released before callbacks/PDP; real DDS owner-deletion regression verifies traversal lifetime.
dds.component_replies: Six exact load_nodeReply writer profiles get 2s; original participant/transports and 100ms default writer policy retained.

writer_unmatch.change: Writer listener snapshot under endpoint mutex; private inline setter synchronized. Release lock before callbacks and PDP updates. Native writer owner lifetime regression.
writer_unmatch.limit: No stack was retained for qualified-v9 bridge SIGSEGV; this independently reproduced writer race is not its proven unique cause.
writer_unmatch.report_label_note: The v10 runs record the new native library SHA while their descriptive fix field still says reader_listener_snapshot. The runtime label was subsequently corrected to reader_writer_listener_snapshot; native code and library bytes are unchanged.

ego_shutdown.reproduced: Actual EGO initialization SIGINT/SIGTERM invalidated Context while the main thread was creating publishers; four native cases aborted.
ego_shutdown.fix: Block process stop signals before thread creation; main thread consumes pending requests, retires executor/FSM/node, then closes Context synchronously.
ego_shutdown.regressions: Same four native cases pass; twelve early/ready/preset-wait active/frozen signal combinations and ten functional CTest targets pass.

cloud_transform_timing.problem: When measurement-time TF was unavailable, the pointcloud filter used latest TF while retaining the measurement timestamp.
cloud_transform_timing.fix: Bounded asynchronous wait for measurement-time TF; no latest fallback, frozen-clock expiry and epoch reset; original geometry and navigation margins retained.
cloud_transform_timing.attribution_limit: The native delayed-TF coordinate error is reproduced. The v8 diagnostic second-cycle route failure was not recorded with a full occupancy-grid snapshot and cannot be uniquely attributed to this defect.

additional_transport_diagnostics.scope: Six rounds of three actual TCP subscribers completed with zero live/pending managers. This does not reproduce or uniquely explain the v8 final retained-manager failure.
